dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, did you see the news about the bank manager?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, dɪd juː ˈsiː ðə ˈnuːz əˈbaʊt ðə ˈbæŋk ˈmænɪdʒər?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes! He was accused of taking money from his elderly customers' accounts, wasn't he?
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! hiː wʌz əˈkjuːzd əv ˈteɪkɪŋ ˈmʌni frəm hɪz ˈɛldərli ˈkʌstəmərz əˈkaʊnts, ˈwʌzənt hiː?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's right. Yesterday he was in court for the first time.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈraɪt. ˈjɛstərdeɪ hiː wʌz ɪn ˈkɔːrt fər ðə ˈfɜːrst ˈtaɪm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: What did he say? Did he admit taking the money?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt dɪd hiː ˈseɪ? dɪd hiː ədˈmɪt ˈteɪkɪŋ ðə ˈmʌni?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: No, he denied taking it. He said someone had hacked his computer.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, hiː dɪˈnaɪd ˈteɪkɪŋ ɪt. hiː ˈsɛd ˈsʌmwʌn hæd ˈhækt hɪz kəmˈpjuːtər.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Not really. The police found the money in his wife's account.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈriːli. ðə pəˈliːs ˈfaʊnd ðə ˈmʌni ɪn hɪz ˈwaɪfs əˈkaʊnt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Wow. So what did the judge say?
dialogue.reading: ˈwaʊ. soʊ ˈwʌt dɪd ðə ˈdʒʌdʒ ˈseɪ?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: The judge asked him to explain. Then he admitted moving the money, but he still denied stealing it.
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈdʒʌdʒ ˈæskt hɪm tu ɪkˈspleɪn. ˈðɛn hiː ədˈmɪtɪd ˈmuːvɪŋ ðə ˈmʌni, bʌt hiː ˈstɪl dɪˈnaɪd ˈstiːlɪŋ ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That sounds like the same thing to me!
dialogue.reading: ðæt ˈsaʊndz ˈlaɪk ðə ˈseɪm ˈθɪŋ tə miː!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Ha! The court will decide next month.
dialogue.reading: ˈhɑː! ðə ˈkɔːrt wɪl dɪˈsaɪd ˈnɛkst ˈmʌnθ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I hope the customers get their money back.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈhoʊp ðə ˈkʌstəmərz ˈɡɛt ðɛr ˈmʌni ˈbæk.
